There are always many people at the swimming pool. David and Jack had great fun there. David thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. A nature walk clears the week's noise.
David spent the weekend at the museum. The weather was rainy that day. David usually has noodles for breakfast. Best of all, I believe you can do it.
David hopes to visit Paris one day. Jack's birthday is in June. The bike lane is one of the best places in the city. In fact, wash your hands before dinner.
Life is full of small surprises. Jack is interested in reading. It takes twenty minutes to get to the bike lane by bike.
